Business goal: Define the standard list capability expected for records managed by a generated or planned entity.
User outcome: A generated management surface can list records using stable pagination lifecycle visibility boundary filtering and search hooks.
Primary actor: Entity maintainer or owning feature actor
Capability boundary: tenant or root depending on owning entity
Tenant context rule: Exactly one current tenant context is required for tenant-scoped entities; root-only entities remain root context.
Authorization posture: Runtime authz capability required; collection views do not grant access.

Complementary governance additions: Collection views may constrain which statuses/sub-statuses are shown by default; staged page visibility controls exposure only.
